description: Lets readers browse and select HTML symbols.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Shows only the title, filters, and a compact 2em symbol grid.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: Free-text filter applied to symbol names and metadata.

events.name: tp-symbol-picker-copy-error
events.description: Emitted when copying the selected symbol fails. The detail contains the requested clipboard text, selection metadata and the caught error.
events.detail: { symbol: string; name: string; group: string; entities: string[]; codepoints: string[]; copy: TpSymbolPickerCopyFormat; value: string; error: unknown }

events.name: tp-symbol-picker-select
events.description: Emitted when a symbol is selected. The detail contains the selection metadata and requested clipboard text; this event does not confirm clipboard success. value is null when the selected copy format has no representation.
events.detail: { symbol: string; name: string; group: string; entities: string[]; codepoints: string[]; copy: TpSymbolPickerCopyFormat; value: string | null }

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-radio-list
dependencies.summary: Transforms a list into a group of radio buttons.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-symbol-picker>` element lets readers browse and select HTML symbols.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Browse or search the available items, then select one to copy it in the chosen format. |
| Using the component | Use the displayed filters and format selector, when available, to narrow the list or change the copied representation. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
